Research the Russian small-and-medium business (МСП) market in TWO verticals for a gig-staffing platform business case. Today is July 2026 — prioritize the freshest data available, nothing older than 2025 unless nothing newer exists.

VERTICAL 1 — WAREHOUSING & LOGISTICS (склады, логистика, ОКВЭД 52):
1. Number of registered МСП entities in warehousing/logistics in Russia (ФНС Единый реестр субъектов МСП / Росстат). IMPORTANT CONTEXT: a prior research pass in this project searched for this specific figure and could NOT find any aggregate ОКВЭД-52 МСП count in open sources. Please verify whether that gap is real, or whether the figure does exist somewhere I missed. Either answer is useful — but be precise about what you searched.
2. If the aggregate count doesn't exist: what are the closest usable proxies? (e.g. number of warehouse facilities, number of ПВЗ/pickup points operated by small operators, number of small transport companies)
3. Labour shortage in warehousing/logistics: deficit figures, which roles (пикеры, комплектовщики, грузчики, водители).
4. How warehouse/logistics companies use temporary labour and самозанятые. Note: existing gig platforms (VentraGo, MyGig, Skilla) appear to serve warehouse clients heavily — confirm and characterise whether those are LARGE clients (Ozon, Wildberries, X5) or small independent operators.

VERTICAL 2 — COURIERS / DELIVERY (курьеры, доставка):
1. Structure of the courier market in Russia: who dominates (Яндекс Доставка, Самокат, Delivery Club/Купер, СДЭК, Boxberry etc.) and what share is in-house vs outsourced/gig.
2. Is there a meaningful SMB-BUYER segment for courier labour — i.e. small businesses that hire couriers themselves rather than using an aggregator's delivery service? (e.g. small online shops, local flower/food shops, pharmacies). Any data on how many such businesses exist or how they solve delivery.
3. Number of самозанятые couriers in Russia and any regulatory notes (ФЗ-289 platform economy law relevance).
4. Whether any existing gig-staffing platform serves SMB courier demand specifically, or whether that demand is absorbed by the big delivery aggregators.

Use live web search — every figure must come with a real URL found in this session, not recalled from training data. Prioritize primary sources: ФНС, Росстат, Минтранс, отраслевые ассоциации, company reports. Secondary press acceptable if it cites a primary source with a date.

CRITICAL: if a specific number does not exist in open sources, say so explicitly. Do NOT estimate, extrapolate, or invent plausible figures. A clearly stated "this data is not published" is a valuable and expected result. For the courier SMB-buyer question in particular, if the honest answer is "this segment appears structurally small / absorbed by aggregators", say that plainly.

Return as a structured list per vertical: FACT | SOURCE | URL | DATE | PRIMARY/SECONDARY. Keep total under 800 words.

Research complete. Findings below.

## VERTICAL 1 — WAREHOUSING & LOGISTICS (ОКВЭД 52)

### 1. Aggregate МСП count for ОКВЭД 52 — **your prior gap is REAL**

I could not find a published aggregate МСП count for ОКВЭД class 52 (or for section H "Транспортировка и хранение"). What I searched and what I found:

| Item | Finding | Source | URL | Date | Type |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Total МСП in Russia | 6,947,425 subjects | PROналоги citing ФНС РМСП | https://pronalogi.press/news/bolsinstvo-subieektov-msp-v-rossii-sostavliaet-mikrobiznes-10300 | Apr 2026 | SECONDARY (cites ФНС) |
| ФНС РМСП statistics portal — available dimensions | Filters by category (микро/малые/средние), ИП/ЮЛ, region, newly-created, social. Shows only "10 самых популярных ОКВЭД" — no full ОКВЭД cross-tab, no export by activity class | ФНС ofd.nalog.ru | https://ofd.nalog.ru/statistics.html | checked Jul 2026 | PRIMARY |
| ФНС РМСП open dataset | Per-entity records only; no published aggregate by ОКВЭД. Structure defined by 209-ФЗ ст.4.1 | ФНС opendata | https://www.nalog.gov.ru/opendata/7707329152-rsmp/ | 12.05.2026 schema | PRIMARY |
| Closest official flow figure | Of МСП created since start of 2024: 38.2% retail/wholesale, **7.8% транспортировка**, 5.9% construction | Правительство РФ (Новак) | http://government.ru/news/51693/ | 2024 | PRIMARY |

**Verdict:** the number is *derivable* (ФНС publishes the per-entity registry with ОКВЭД fields, so you could compute it from the open dataset dump) but it is **not published in aggregate anywhere in open sources**. Note the 7.8% figure covers "транспортировка" broadly (section H, dominated by ОКВЭД 49 road freight), not class 52 specifically — do not use it as a 52 proxy.

### 2. Usable proxies

| Fact | Source | URL | Date | Type |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 226,400 ПВЗ operating in Russia (+44.7% YoY) | Ведомости / Kommersant, citing Infoline | https://www.vedomosti.ru/business/news/2026/01/19/1170105-chislo-pvz-v-rossii | 01.01.2026 | SECONDARY (cites Infoline) |
| 231,100 ПВЗ, +25% YoY | Яндекс Карты via РИА Недвижимость | https://realty.ria.ru/20260512/pvz-2090656317.html | 31.03.2026 | SECONDARY |
| WB ~94,000 ПВЗ; Ozon >85,000 | New Retail | https://new-retail.ru/novosti/retail/chislo_pvz_v_rossii_za_god_vyroslo_na_44_7/ | Jan 2026 | SECONDARY |

ПВЗ are the strongest proxy — most are franchise/ИП-operated micro-businesses. I found **no** published count of warehouse facilities operated by МСП, nor of small transport companies.

### 3. Labour shortage

| Fact | Source | URL | Date | Type |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 89% of logistics companies report staff shortage; 25% say it threatens operations | НЦПО | https://ncpo.ru/blog/rynok-truda-v-logistike-2026-za-kogo-boryutsya-rabotodateli/ | 2026 | SECONDARY |
| Driver deficit (cat. C/E) 25–30%; warehouses understaffed 30–40% | Habr / Intekey | https://habr.com/ru/companies/intekey/articles/1039938/ | 2026 | SECONDARY |
| Vacancy mix: >⅓ drivers, 19% упаковщики/комплектовщики, 14% couriers | РЖД-Партнёр | https://www.rzd-partner.ru/logistics/comments/rynok-truda-2026-kakikh-spetsialistov-i-kak-ishchut-dlya-raboty-v-logisticheskoy-sfere/ | 2026 | SECONDARY |

**Contradicting signal worth flagging:** logistics.ru reports the line-personnel deficit is *easing* in 2026 — https://logistics.ru/rabota-i-karera-v-logistike-upravlenie-logistikoy-i-kompaniey/lineynyy-personal-perestal-byt

### 4. Gig platforms and their client size — **partially unconfirmed**

| Fact | Source | URL | Date | Type |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ventra holding revenue 24.1 bn ₽ (+25%) | ventrago.ru | https://ventrago.ru/blog/vyruchka-holdinga-ventra | FY2024 | PRIMARY (company) |
| Skilla revenue 7 bn ₽ | TopFranchise | https://topfranchise.ru/products/franshiza-marketpleysa-dlya-zakazchikov-i-ispolniteley-skilla/ | FY2024 | SECONDARY |
| MyGig raised 120 mn ₽ from MTS | SmartRanking | https://smartranking.ru/ru/ranking/company/mygig/ | 2025 | SECONDARY |
| Ventra Go roles: сборщик заказов, разнорабочий, курьер, работник торгового зала | ventrago.ru/business | https://ventrago.ru/business | Jul 2026 | PRIMARY |

**I could not confirm client composition.** Ventra Go's site shows client logos as images only, with no named companies and no stated minimum order size. No open source I found breaks these platforms' revenue by client size. The "they serve Ozon/WB/X5" assumption is **plausible but unverified in open sources** — treat it as a hypothesis requiring expert interviews, not a fact.

---

## VERTICAL 2 — COURIERS / DELIVERY

### 1. Market structure

| Fact | Source | URL | Date | Type |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Express delivery market → 600 bn ₽ by end-2026; +30% in 2025, +20% forecast 2026 | MegaResearch | https://www.megaresearch.ru/new_reality/ekspress-dostavka-tovarov-v-logistike-tekuschee-sostoyanie-rynka-i-faktory-ego-rosta | 2026 | SECONDARY |
| Leaders by audience/engagement: СДЭК, Яндекс Доставка, Почта России | Brand Analytics | https://brandanalytics.ru/blog/delivery-market-2026-the-battle-for-the-last-mile | Q4 2025 | SECONDARY |
| **>70% of major platforms' deliveries go through their own in-house services** | Infoline via AdIndex | https://adindex.ru/publication/analitics/search/2026/03/16/343225.phtml | Mar 2026 | SECONDARY (cites Infoline) |

That 70% in-house figure is the single most important number for your thesis — it directly bounds the outsourced/gig share of the large-player segment.

### 2. SMB-buyer segment — **honest answer: structurally small / absorbed**

I found **no data** on how many small businesses hire couriers directly, and no market sizing for SMB-as-courier-buyer. What exists is only qualitative vendor content describing SMB behaviour, which uniformly says small businesses **outsource to aggregators rather than hire**:

| Fact | Source | URL | Date | Type |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| SMBs lack resources for in-house couriers at launch stage; outsourcing is the default | ЕКАМ | https://www.ekam.ru/blogs/pos/autsorsing-kuryerskikh-uslug-ili-sobstvennaya-sluzhba | n.d. | SECONDARY (vendor) |
| Market splits into federal logistics (СДЭК, Boxberry, DPD), local B2B last-mile providers, fulfilment+delivery, and aggregators | Sostav | https://www.sostav.ru/blogs/284331/88760 | 2026 | SECONDARY (vendor blog) |

**State this plainly in the business case:** SMB courier demand appears absorbed by aggregators (Dostavista, Яндекс Доставка, СДЭК) which already sell per-delivery with no headcount commitment. A gig-*staffing* layer would be competing against a cheaper, lower-friction substitute. No open data contradicts this, and none supports a sizeable independent SMB courier-hiring segment.

### 3. Самозанятые couriers and regulation

| Fact | Source | URL | Date | Type |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| ~1.5 mn couriers in Russia (Минпромторг estimate) | Milknews citing Минпромторг | https://milknews.ru/index/minpromtorg-kuryery-apk.html | 2025 | SECONDARY (cites ministry) |
| Growth: 830k (2021) → >1 mn (2023) | TAdviser | https://www.tadviser.ru/index.php/Статья:Курьеры_в_России | 2025 | SECONDARY |
| Shortage ~200k, peaking seasonally | S-Pro | https://s-pro.group/tpost/49r8n05dn1-rinok-kurerskoi-dostavki-2026-chto-izmen | 2026 | SECONDARY |
| 15.27 mn самозанятые total (+25% YoY); **>60% of platform couriers are самозанятые** | Qugo | https://qugo.ru/blog/platformennaya-zanyatost-i-platformennaya-ekonomika-v-2026-godu | early 2026 | SECONDARY |
| **289-ФЗ in force 01.10.2026**: platform-worker legal status; couriers stay самозанятые/ИП, no ТК guarantees | Альфа-Банк | https://kurs.alfabank.ru/articles/289-fz-novye-pravila-platformennoj-zanyatosti/ | 2026 | SECONDARY (cites law) |
| Platform must block interaction if one performer exceeds threshold hours with one client for 6 consecutive months | Qugo | https://qugo.ru/blog/60-chasov-v-mesyacz-s-odnim-zakazchikom-novoe-ogranichenie-dlya-raboty-cherez-czifrovye-platformy | 2026 | SECONDARY |

Caveat: two sources gave conflicting thresholds (60 h/month vs 160 h/month). Verify against the statute text before citing — I did not reach the primary 289-ФЗ text in this session.

### 4. Does any gig platform serve SMB courier demand specifically?

**No evidence found that any does.** Platforms I identified — Ventra Go, MyGig, Skilla, Наймикс (https://naimix.ru/business), Qugo (https://qugo.ru/), GigWork (https://gigwork.ru/) — position as B2B mass-staffing or самозанятые-payment-compliance rails. Наймикс and Qugo are compliance/payout infrastructure rather than supply marketplaces. None advertises an SMB courier-hiring product. This is an absence of evidence in open sources, not proof of absence.

---

## Three things to carry into the Six Pager

The ОКВЭД-52 gap is confirmed and worth stating as a methodology note rather than papering over — ФНС holds the data per-entity but publishes no aggregate, so the honest move is either to compute it from the open dataset dump yourself or to use ПВЗ counts as the proxy and say why.

The weakest link in the current thesis is the courier SMB-buyer segment. I found nothing supporting it and a clear structural reason it shouldn't exist: aggregators already sell per-delivery with zero headcount commitment, which beats gig-staffing on friction for a shop doing a handful of deliveries a day. If the business case depends on that segment, it needs primary research before it can carry weight.

The claim that existing gig platforms serve large warehouse clients — which shapes your whitespace argument — is unverified. Ventra Go publishes client logos as images with no names, and no open source breaks any platform's revenue by client size. That's an expert-interview question, not a desk-research one.
